correctness.rationale: PASS: For the full cube, commuting coordinate flips give A²=(d mod 2)I in characteristic two, hence C=A+delta I is square-zero of rank N/2 from coordinate splitting. The deleted-vertex compression satisfies B²=delta I+aa^T+bb^T; truncated neighborhood columns have independent rank except the explicit d=2,h=2 case. Their Gram and feedback identities R²=(delta+e)R and Ba=eb, Bb=ea determine ranks of B, B² and shifted powers. These reconstruct exactly the listed J2(1), J3(0), J4(1), J1(0), J2(0) blocks and their multiplicities. Nilpotent-entry strata and kernels of (B-I)^{2^k} give exact finite-field periods. Independently reproduced GF2 rank/nullity profile for d=2..6 and every distance h, but the universal characteristic-two proof is algebraic and not inferred from finite cases.
